name: Plagueheart Bindings
label: Quest
description: Plagueheart Bindings: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I make no pretenses, maggot. The darkness Plagueheart items hold could very well destroy the both of us. That is why the price is so high. If I'm going to die, it's going to be as a rich man.
And I don't give an ounce of gnoll spit how you die, only that you do as I ask. Bring me what I require and we will both benefit - or die; but I've already explained this...

clips.title: Progress
paras: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!

clips.title: Completion
paras: , you got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Plagueheart Bindings.
